requirement.evidence: All notices to terminate a tenancy for all rental units subject to City’s Rent Stabilization Ordinance (RSO) must be filed with the Los Angeles Housing Department (LAHD) within three (3) business days of service on the tenant
requirement.note: Lists of at-fault and no-fault reasons, relocation, declaration and 30/60/120-day notices are supported. The 'only for a listed reason' exclusivity is not stated explicitly, and the 'illegal use' and 'nuisance' items are paraphrased.

key_value.evidence: No-fault evictions require the payment of relocation assistance.
key_value.note: The 3 business days filing is also stated in the document.

effective_date.note: Field is empty on the card.
